answer_1.quote: The task of document‑grounded dialog response generation is to predict the next response, r = ⟨r1 r2 … rT⟩, one token at a time, given the dialog history h and the document d.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, RougeL, BERTScore, FaithCritic, Q2, UPMI‑FAITH, and our proposed PMI‑FAITH to evaluate the generated responses, reporting precision, recall, F1, accuracy, Spearman/Pearson correlation and AUROC.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation experiments to compare (1) relevance, (2) faithfulness, and (3) grammar. All three dimensions were categorically labeled as agree, neutral, or disagree. We report the percentage of responses that were rated agree and use Fleiss Kappa to measure inter‑annotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated response on faithfulness, relevance, and grammar using an agree/neutral/disagree scale.
